rules.title: Reprisal for reporting violations of law or for tenant's union activity; damages and costs; notice of termination, presumption; waiver in leases or other rental agreements prohibited
rules.requirement: A landlord or agent who retaliates against a tenant for reporting violations, exercising tenant rights, or union activity is liable for damages of at least one month's rent and up to three months' rent or actual damages, plus costs and attorney's fees. Notices of termination or rent increase within six months of such tenant activity create a presumption of retaliation, rebuttable only by clear and convincing evidence. Waivers of this provision in leases are void.
rules.summary_plain: If your landlord tries to evict you or raise your rent because you reported problems or joined a tenant union, you can claim damages and the law protects you from retaliation. Notices within six months of your protected activity are presumed retaliatory unless the landlord proves otherwise.
rules.summary_plain_es: Si su arrendador intenta desalojarlo o aumentar su renta porque reportó problemas o se unió a un sindicato de inquilinos, puede reclamar daños y perjuicios y la ley lo protege contra represalias. Los avisos dentro de seis meses de su actividad protegida se presumen retaliatorios a menos que el arrendador demuestre lo contrario.
rules.coverage_conditions_text: Applies to tenants of residential premises in Massachusetts.
rules.exemptions_text: No waivers of this protection are valid in leases or rental agreements.
rules.quoted_span: Any person or agent thereof who threatens to or takes reprisals against any tenant of residential premises for the tenant's act of... reporting or complaining of such violation or suspected violation... or for organizing or joining a tenants' union... shall be liable for damages which shall not be less than one month's rent or more than three month's rent... The receipt of any notice of termination of tenancy... within six months after the tenant has commenced... such action... shall create a rebuttable presumption that such notice or other action is a reprisal against the tenant... Any waiver of this provision in any lease or other rental agreement shall be void and unenforceable.
